subject.title: Feature: Trigger model fallback on context length exceeded

question: Should exhausted context overflow become eligible for configured model fallback when a candidate has a larger verified context window?
rationale: Current source and documentation deliberately make overflow compaction-only, so changing it requires explicit policy for replay safety, context-window metadata, and session fallback persistence.

options.title: Guarded larger-model fallback
options.body: Retry only after same-model recovery is exhausted, no delivery or side effects committed, and a configured candidate has verified headroom.

options.title: Keep compaction-only
options.body: Preserve the blocked overflow result and document manual model or session recovery as the intended contract.

recommendation.title: Guarded larger-model fallback
recommendation.body: Retry only after same-model recovery is exhausted, no delivery or side effects committed, and a configured candidate has verified headroom.

likelyOwner.reason: He has recent merged history across failover classification and embedded overflow handling and previously reviewed this specific policy boundary.
